descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-08 Handoff Summary · S24 「真 iPhone 和 Android：Copy 后粘贴到别的 app；没有邮件 app 或分享面板；手机时钟错了不改变记录」 Real iPhone and Android: Copy and paste into another app; no mail app or share sheet; a wrong phone clock does not change the record

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U9 A 'Copy' button copies the current handoff text, including any edits, to the clipboard, the same as 'Copy to EMR' on the note; copying stays on the device and nothing is emailed or shared.（UAT TC-08；TFA-92586 AC 9） — gate: blocked: TFA-92586 ready for pr
  • U8 No email client opens, no mailto: link fires, and there is no email or external-share path for a handoff under any condition, failures included (the After-Pilot no-PHI email notification is absent to …（UAT TC-08；TFA-92586 AC 6） — gate: blocked: TFA-92586 ready for pr
  • U11 The record's timestamp follows the server clock (3.8): a sender device with a wrong date or time zone does not change the recorded send time.（UAT 3.8；UAT TC-08） — gate: blocked: TFA-92586 ready for pr
  • U6 Every sent handoff leaves a persistent record (sender, recipient, timestamp) that both the sender and the recipient can retrieve.（UAT TC-08；TFA-92586 AC 8） — gate: blocked: TFA-92586 ready for pr

测试设计方法：设备（device） — 在手机尺寸或真机（iPhone / Pixel）上看布局和手势。

Given iOS and Android builds pointed at a non-dev backend, @roundai.test sender and recipient with synthetic patients; for the clock part, the sender's phone set two days ahead and in another time zone

When Open Handoff, edit, tap Copy, paste into Notes (or another app); look for any email or share action; send to the colleague with the phone clock two days ahead; the recipient opens it on a correctly set device

Then The pasted text matches the edited handoff; no email app opens and no system share sheet is offered at any point; the record's send time on both sides is the real (server) time; the title/header date is recorded for Q8

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Tester compares the pasted text with the S03a/S03b clipboard checkpoints, records any mail/share surface, and compares the record's time with the server time (3.8). The web half of the clock check is automated in S20

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 DEVICE · 真机（iOS / Android）；矩阵里排的车道 人工（manual）

S24 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-08.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：DEVICE · 真机（iOS / Android）；辅助：PW · Playwright 脚本 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
